freeze_policy: Eligibility and the denominator are independent of proof status. Any split or semantic change requires a new registry version and an explicit old/new ID delta.

obligations.statement: The exact two-open-set based Seifert-van Kampen target in Statement.lean.
For fixed cover data, the ambient fundamental group satisfies the stated pushout universal property.
The two maps from the intersection fundamental group to the ambient fundamental group are equal.
FundamentalGroup.map respects the equal continuous inclusion composites needed by SVK-SQUARE.
Every compatible pair of homomorphisms from the two cover pieces extends to the ambient fundamental group.
Every based loop has a finite subdivision whose consecutive restricted paths lie in U or in V, with endpoint membership data.
The pullback of the open cover along a loop admits a finite interval subdivision subordinate to the cover.
Paths inside U, V, and their path-connected intersection transport segment endpoints to the chosen basepoint compatibly.
A subordinate subdivision and basepoint transports produce a word alternating between the two piece fundamental groups.
Define the value of a compatible cocone on one chosen subdivided and transported loop word.
Word evaluation is invariant under refinement, choice of cover label, basepaths, loop representative, and based homotopy.
Inserting subdivision points or changing a segment label on overlap preserves the compatible word value.
A based homotopy grid decomposes into overlap-compatible elementary cells, so its boundary words have equal value.
The well-defined word evaluation preserves identity, multiplication, and inverse and restricts to the prescribed maps on U and V.
Any two ambient homomorphisms restricting to the given maps on both cover pieces are equal.
Every ambient fundamental-group element is represented by a finite product of images from the U and V fundamental groups.
Homomorphisms agreeing on both piece images agree on every finite product supplied by SVK-GENERATION.

exclusions.reason: Alternate presentation only; it enters the denominator only after a checked equivalence to the canonical universal property.
Strictly broader theorem and not a substitute for the frozen based target.
Human-source review is tracked in the provenance/documentation graph, not counted as a logical proof obligation.

status_boundary: The registry freezes architecture and open interfaces only. No logical leaf or root proof is claimed. Step budgets are split thresholds awaiting substantive ledgers, not R0 evidence.
